method: Built-in image_gen; original generated game assets, optimized to WebP without changing aspect ratios.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait 2:3 environment artwork for Midnight Run. Create a new neon entertainment district matching the provided overhead street reference's camera, road scale, tactile hand-painted realistic 3D art quality and continuous vertical street composition. Reference is style and geometry only. A perfectly straight north-south rain-dark asphalt road occupies the center with curbs at 35% and 65% width, sidewalks, and cropped rooftop buildings at the far edges, near-vertical orthographic overhead view, no horizon. Add varied casino, strip club, late-night diner and small hotel exterior buildings, believable roof vents and awnings. Signs mounted to buildings seen from above are readable: 'CASINO', 'VELVET', small 'STRIP CLUB', 'DINER', 'HOTEL'. Bright hot pink, cyan, violet and amber neon signs and trim cast beautiful broad colored reflections across the wet sidewalks and road. Show several distinct venues alternating on either side, not repetitive identical buildings. Keep road center open from top to bottom, no people or cars, no UI, no arrows, no sexual imagery. A narrow side street crossing the center halfway down. Cinematic textured midnight atmosphere, luminous rich signs but restrained dark road for gameplay readability. Preserve 2:3 aspect ratio.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game background asset for Midnight Run, a high-quality top-down night-time crime-city runner. This is environment artwork only, not a screenshot, no UI, no text or lettering.
Composition: portrait 2:3 image, orthographic near-vertical top-down camera with only a little depth visible on building walls. A long narrow north-south asphalt street occupies the CENTER 44 percent of the width from top to bottom, fully open for a runner. Wide cracked sidewalks border it. Cropped decrepit brick buildings and industrial rooftops frame the far left and right edges, with roof vents, fire escapes, closed metal doors, dumpsters, a few trash bags and a few torn papers. A worn diagonal pedestrian crossing halfway up the open street, one open side alley on each edge at different heights. No people, no cars in the central street, no readable signs, no arrows.
Art direction: cohesive premium hand-painted 3D game art, tactile painted materials, realistic grounded proportions, cinematic noir, handsome rich dark petrol-blue and charcoal with restrained amber light. Detailed worn brick, cracked cobblestone curb, rain-dark asphalt with subtle reflections and puddles. Visibly textured but clean readable center at small phone size. Several warm amber streetlights along the sidewalks with beautiful soft pools of light and convincing cast shadows, subdued cyan reflected window lights. Attractive balanced local contrasts, not pitch black. Absolutely no neon cyberpunk colors, no giant buildings viewed from side, no perspective vanishing point. Fill entire frame; clean rectangular image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a second environment background for the same top-down Midnight Run game, matching the reference's camera, material quality, road width and noir amber/petrol palette. No UI or text. Output portrait 2:3.
Preserve the long perfectly north-south road centered from top to bottom, occupying CENTER 44 percent of width, with sidewalks and cropped buildings on left and right. Completely new industrial dockside block: older warehouses with corrugated roof panels, rusty ventilation stacks, an inset loading bay, stacked wooden pallets and restrained little cargo crates tucked off the road, a chainlink fence on one side, a recessed service yard. A broad cross street at the middle. Worn white road lane markings only around the intersection. Warm industrial wall lamps and streetlamps cast beautiful local pools of amber light. A few puddles reflecting blue moonlight and amber lights. Central runner corridor stays open, no cars, no people, no obstructions.
Premium detailed hand-painted 3D art, crisp believable rough asphalt and brick, orthographic nearly overhead view without vanishing point, cinematic shadowing readable on a phone. The same scale as reference. Moody, handsome and restrained, not neon cyberpunk. No text or readable signage, no arrows, no UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Third production background for the Midnight Run game. Match reference camera, scale, realistic worn materials and rich nocturnal petrol-blue/amber palette exactly. Portrait 2:3 top-down orthographic street.
A different residential/market district. Long north-south open wet road centered from top to bottom, occupying center 44 percent width with exact same straight curb positions as reference. Left and right edges framed by cropped narrow old brick apartment rooftops, enclosed fire escapes, and a few lowered striped weathered awnings over shuttered shops. A small tiny takeaway window glows subdued turquoise, several warm incandescent amber streetlamps cast soft realistic light pools and deep directional shadows. Add a small tiled outdoor courtyard at one edge with broken planter, and a cluster of bins down one side alley. A few paper scraps, drain grids, deep rain reflections. Sparse faded street paint. No people, no vehicles. Clear central running corridor, no obstructions on roadway. No big intersection; instead branching narrow alleys on alternating sides.
Beautiful professional tactile hand-painted 3D game art. Nearly vertical camera with a little wall depth as in reference. Dark but clear, not over-saturated, no cyberpunk. No lettering, signs with text, logos, UI or arrows. No perspective vanishing point.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for the Midnight Run top-down crime-city game. Exactly FOUR frames in a regular 2 by 2 grid on a transparent square canvas. Each equal square quadrant contains the SAME adult urban runner at the SAME size, the SAME center placement, facing UP towards the TOP edge. A directly overhead camera, so we see crown of hood, shoulders, forearms and shoes. NO side-on characters. Do not show faces.
Character: charcoal hooded jacket, a compact ochre tan canvas sling bag across the back, dark slate trousers, off-white sneaker soles, no weapons. Premium tactile hand-painted 3D game art, believable proportions, cinematic cool night highlights and warm amber edge lighting, clean readable silhouette. Crisp natural shadows within clothing, transparent backdrop with NO ground shadows, no floor. Maximum character height about 60 percent of each quadrant so all extended limbs fit comfortably.
Animation frames: top-left right foot forward left foot back and left arm forward; top-right legs almost passing and arms almost parallel; bottom-left left foot forward right foot back and right arm forward; bottom-right legs passing with opposite arm pose. Four distinctly different overhead running-cycle poses. Alignment is essential. No text, no labels, no gridlines, no extra props, no duplicate people in any quadrant. 2 columns 2 rows exactly.

Use case: stylized-concept. A single production game sprite: a worn 1990s black-and-ivory patrol sedan seen from directly overhead, front bumper pointing UP to the TOP of the image. Transparent background. Full car within frame, with clean generous padding. No police lettering, no text, no real logos. Red and blue glass lightbar on the roof, black windshield with subtle cool reflections, worn metallic panel edges, pale ivory doors, realistic wheels. Premium hand-painted 3D game art, cinematic moody petrol-blue ambient shading, warm amber edge highlight, realistic grounded proportions. Camera nearly vertical top-down, we mostly see the roof, hood and rear trunk. It must integrate with detailed overhead wet asphalt and warm streetlight game art. NO floor, NO roadway, NO long ground shadow, NO exterior light beams or glow outside the vehicle: these will be rendered dynamically in game. Exactly one car, not a sheet.

audio.other: Original Web Audio rain/traffic bed, minor ostinato, clasp, escape chord and restrained patrol-stop cue.
